name: Dandelion
description: Use paper cranes to convey wishes and interpret romance with the language of flowers. There are four types of flowers in the series - exquisite peach blossom, flaming glory orchid, purple lavender and misty snow dandelion. Each flower has its own personality and meaning. Two kinds of packaging, multiple floral experiences: the flower set box is equipped with exclusive flower language glass balls and flower language hanging tags, allowing you to freely unlock the flower language wind chime hanging decoration; the fragrant gift box is equipped with flower fragrance components to add olfactory floral enjoyment and freely create a flower scene. The language of flowers expresses feelings, and the thousand cranes make a gift. The world full of flowers is particularly sunny, warm and gentle.
